abstract: A case with neonatal teratoma originating from the cervicofacial region which transformed to be malignant during treatment is reported. The case is a full-term baby girl with swallowing difficulty and has a mass at the floor of her mouth with the right neck swelling. The mass was revealed to be multi-cystic and extending deep into the sublingual space and protruding outside. Puncture and marsupialisation of the cyst could not relieve her symptom and the tumor was resected in three occasions and was diagnosed as mature teratoma without malignant component. However, three months after the last resection, the solid right neck mass enlarged rapidly and the serum alpha-fetoprotein level was elevated. Biopsied specimen demonstrated the mass to be germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor component. Eight courses of JEB regimen with recurrent mass resection successfully lead to complete regression without compromising patient growth as well as cosmetics. Head and neck teratomas in children are mostly benign amenable to curative excision but its rarity and site and size of the tumor make its treatment challenging. It is important to have multi-disciplinary management for the disease from neonatal period until growth has finished. There exists a relationship between the age at diagnosis and outcome of a patient with teratoma and head and neck teratomas in neonate are mostly benign but should be removed completely as soon as the patient condition is stabilized to reduce the risk of malignant change.
abstract_ja: 頭頸部から発生した新生児奇形腫が治療中に悪性転化した症例を報告する。症例は満期産の女児で、嚥下困難があり、口腔底の腫瘤と右頸部腫脹を認めた。腫瘤は多嚢胞性で、舌下間隙の深部まで進展し、外部に突出していた。穿刺とのう胞のマースピアリゼーション（開窓術）では症状が改善しなかった。腫瘍は3回切除され、成熟奇形腫で悪性成分を認めないと診断された。しかし最後の切除から3か月後、右頸部の充実性腫瘤が急速に増大し、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値が上昇した。生検標本では、胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。JEB療法8コースと再発腫瘤の切除により、成長や整容を損なうことなく完全寛解が得られた。小児の頭頸部奇形腫は多くが良性で完全切除により治癒可能であるが、その稀少性と部位・大きさのため治療は困難である。新生児期から成長終了まで多職種による管理が重要である。診断時の年齢と転帰には関連があり、新生児の頭頸部奇形腫は多くが良性であるが、悪性変化のリスクを減らすため、全身状態が安定次第、完全に切除すべきである。
